chunks: And Sahl ibn Ziyad reported from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shamoun, from Al-Asamm, from Misma' ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, referring to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ: Sahl ibn Ziyad, a prominent Shia narrator
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ شَمُّونٍ: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shamoun, a narrator
key_terms.مِسْمَعُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ: Misma' ibn Abd al-Malik, a narrator

ai.seo_question: Who are the narrators in the chain for this hadith from Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This narration, recorded by Sahl ibn Ziyad in *al-Kafi*, corroborates the ruling on the 'Trio' (three sa' of grain) and *Al-Ihsa’a* (flour mixed with oil) through a distinct chain leading to Imam al-Sadiq. It highlights the scholarly practice of cross-referencing narrators to establish the reliability and consistency of fiqh rulings regarding zakat and food measurements in Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali:
And Sahl Biin Ziyad reported from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Al Asamma, from Misma’a Bin Abdul Malik,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> –
